description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nittambuwa, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510607
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and deals specifically with land registration matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
